schema.name: files
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE files (
  path TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  mtime_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
  size INTEGER NOT NULL,
  thread_id TEXT,
  cwd TEXT,
  source TEXT NOT NULL,
  date TEXT NOT NULL,
  bytes_ingested INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  last_ord INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  repo_key TEXT
)

schema.name: idx_msgs_ts
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_msgs_ts ON msgs(ts DESC)

schema.name: meta
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE meta (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL)

schema.name: msgs
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE msgs (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  path TEXT NOT NULL,
  ord INTEGER NOT NULL,
  ts TEXT NOT NULL,
  role TEXT NOT NULL,
  match_field TEXT NOT NULL,
  synthetic INTEGER NOT NULL,
  text TEXT NOT NULL
)
